method: Second pass: every Italian source and Spanish translation read and semantically compared by a Claude Haiku 5.5 subagent; false assertions retained; corrections recorded with before/after and reason.

corrections.before: El transporte de mercancías por carretera está sujeto obligatoriamente a un sistema de tarifas con límites mínimos y máximos
corrections.after: El transporte de mercancías por carretera está sujeto obligatoriamente a un sistema de tarifas de horquilla
corrections.reason: 'tariffe a forcella' is a tariff term (horquilla rates); the draft's gloss 'con límites mínimos y máximos' is not in the Italian

corrections.before: El refugio peatonal es una persona encargada de prestar primeros auxilios
corrections.after: El salvavidas es una persona encargada de prestar primeros auxilios
corrections.reason: The Italian statement is that 'salvagente' (lifebuoy, here as a person) is in charge of first aid; the draft's 'refugio peatonal' does not fit the sentence
